PMK Founder Ramadoss Retires, Passes Leadership to Son

PMK founder S. Ramadoss, aged 88, has retired from politics. He has handed over the party leadership to his son, Anbumani Ramadoss. Ramadoss's political career spanned decades and significantly influenced Tamil Nadu's reservation policies and caste politics.
